name: hero
description: Page hero: centred eyebrow, headline with a gradient accent line, lede, body, calls to action and compliance badges over blurred colour orbs; a frosted product-video frame; a client-logo strip. Figma: Home Page > Hero (4331:28767). The reference component — copy its shape when adding new components.

title.description: Main heading. Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: Final heading line in the brand gradient, e.g. You Stay Compliant.

lede.description: Bold line directly under the heading.

subtitle.description: Supporting body copy under the lede.

cta_label.description: Primary button text. Renders only when both cta_label and cta_url are set.

secondary_label.description: Secondary (outline) button text. Renders only with secondary_url.

secondary_mobile_only.description: Show the secondary button on phones only (the desktop design has a single button).

badges_label.description: Small label above the badge row, e.g. Compliance Certifications.

badges.description: Compliance badges. Each entry: image (URL) and alt.

media_video.description: Product video URL (.mp4) shown in the frosted frame. Plays muted and looped.

media_image.description: Poster image for the video, or the frame image when there is no video.

media_alt.description: Accessible description of the video or image.

logos_label.description: Heading of the client-logo strip, e.g. Trusted by thousands of organizations.

logos_accent.description: Coloured continuation of the strip heading, e.g. managing millions of assets worldwide.

logos.description: Client logos. Each entry: image (URL) and alt.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the hero copy.
